title: Count the Errors
story: Dawn on-call. The log file has hundreds of lines and you only need the number of ERROR lines.
goal: Write count_errors(lines): return how many lines contain the word ERROR.
hints: Loop over the lines and check each one with the in operator.
Keep a counter. Add 1 when "ERROR" in line.
socratic: What do you check for each line?
What should happen when the list is empty?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Count the Errors”?
alt:
def count_errors(lines):
    return sum(1 for line in lines if "ERROR" in line)
